pack: Martin Krpan gameplay sprites and separate mare-lifting folk-art concept

canvas.format: PNG RGBA, transparent background, binary alpha

gameConvention.inspected: main/src/game.js: SPR_SIZE.krpan = 48; current sprite is a 96×48 strip containing two 48×48 frames.
gameConvention.integrationStatus: Artwork only. Existing inline SPRITES.krpan is not replaced and no gameplay code or mechanics are changed.

artDirection: Modernized SNES/GBA-inspired pixel art, broad readable silhouette, wide hat, prominent moustache, cream shirt, red vest and sash, salt sack, dark trousers and boots, restrained warm palette and dark outline.

processing.sourceAtlases: Six generated 2×2 pose atlases at 1263×1246. Each frame source cell is 631×623; the unused final source row/column is omitted.
processing.exports: Each cell is cropped separately, downsampled to 48×48 using nearest-neighbor, aligned so the lowest opaque pixel is row 47, alpha thresholded at 128 to preserve hard transparent edges, and quantized to the same 27-color palette.
processing.preview: The labeled preview is for review only. It is not a production sprite sheet and is not read by the game.

sequences.label: Weighty limewood cudgel strike; action description only, not assigned to a progression skill name.
Two separate bare-handed punches; no weapon attack.
Mare presents two sacks; Krpan takes and throws them. The mare remains calm and is not an attacker.
Krpan braces, lifts, winds up and throws one boulder. No target count or damage is specified by these images.
Draw, precise single slash, restrained bleed cue, recovery. Asset name does not resolve the current skill-name conflict.

runtimeSheet.note: Maintains the existing idle | attack two-frame layout for implementation review.

folkArt.type: separate narrative illustration; not a gameplay sprite and not the final Brdavs story card
folkArt.literaryNote: Levstik's text describes Krpan carrying the mare and its load aside for the carriage. The overhead lift shown here is an artistic interpretation, not a literal staging specified by the passage.

openDecisions: Character specification names Lipov kij, Kmečka moč and Mesarica; current progression design and code use Zamah, Kobilica and Lipov kij. These frames are named by visible action only; skill-to-asset mapping remains OPEN.
Animation timing and final runtime integration remain OPEN for implementation review.
The mare-lifting folk-art illustration's exact placement remains OPEN.
The final Brdavs story card is a separate confirmed subject and is not part of this asset pack.

sources.claim: Primary literary source for Krpan, his mare and the carriage episode.
sources.note: The passage says Krpan carried the mare with its load to the side of the road; the overhead illustration is labeled as interpretation.

sources.claim: Project-approved character identity and game-art interpretation boundaries.

reviewStatus: PROPOSED — Game Director review required; assets are not approved or integrated.
